bullets.text: AI Startups Surge - The telco AI market is set to explode from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
Diverse 5G Strategies - AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile are pursuing distinct paths in their 5G network developments.
BBOX AI's Innovation - This startup focuses on customer care automation through advanced conversational AI solutions.
Verizon's Control - The carrier is building a fully virtualised network infrastructure, avoiding reliance on hyperscalers.
NLPearl's Voice AI - This startup aims to enhance call centre efficiency with AI agents that mimic human conversation.
